headline: Sensex and Nifty decline in early trade amid profit-taking, dragged down by major IT stocks

marketStatus.message: Market is open for trading today.

why: Profit-taking sets in after recent market gains.
Weakness in IT sector heavyweights drags the benchmark indices lower.
Sensex dropped over 300 points while Nifty moved below the 24,900 mark.
Sensex and Nifty ended Muhurat trading in the red for the first time since 2017.
whatHappening: Rupee strengthened by 24 paise to 93.74 against the U.S. dollar in early trade.
Citi expressed a bullish outlook on Indian equities, targeting Nifty at 28,000 by end-2027.
India VIX dropped by 9% during morning trading hours.
Honasa Consumer shares extended their rally, jumping over 5% following Q2 results.
summary: Indian equity benchmarks Sensex and Nifty slipped into the red during early trade on Monday due to profit-taking. Key IT majors including HCL Tech, Infosys, and TCS were among the top drags, along with Bharti Airtel and HFCL. Meanwhile, Honasa Consumer rallied over 5% post Q2 results, and Citi issued a long-term bullish target of 28,000 for Nifty by end-2027.
